ctx.x: Yes. Well, as I say, this was what attracted him. This caused him to, you know, want to get in -- he heard me do the thing and so when he called, when I did talk with him, he told me he heard me on the show, and he says, "I was hoping that you'd get to do more." Said, "I want to hear you do more." And I says, "Well, I was just lucky." I really was.
